:::{#exr-epe-split-noise}
#### Separate the noise

Let $\paren{\newpredvar, \newoutvar}$ be a [new observation](#def-new-observation) relative to the random [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$.
Let $\newpredvar = \predvar$.
Let $\noise$ be the [noise](#def-noise) of $\newoutvar$.
Let $\varpar \eqdef \Var{\noise}$ be its [population variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance), which we take to be finite.
Take every expectation below to be conditional on $\newpredvar = \predvar$.
Add and subtract $\truemeanf{\predvar}$ inside the square of the [expected prediction error](#def-epe),

$$
\E{\sqf{\newoutvar - \predvalf{\predvar}}},
$$

expand it, and take the expectation term by term.

Two of the three terms simplify.
Say what each becomes,
and name which facts about the noise hold by definition
and which hypothesis makes the cross term zero.

:::
